test_title: PYST 53: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements: Some papers are pens.

All the pencils are pens.

Conclusions (I): Some pens are pencils.

Conclusions (II): Some pens are papers.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9eba63fe547d740f5a29054d055326a6bd059c3912adf91ca0adac94cd67779.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some pens are pencils → **True **(As, All the pencils are pens. so, Some pens are pencils holds true).

(II): Some pens are papers → **True **(As, Some papers are pens. so, Some pens are papers holds true)

Thus, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
